name: Cumbres de Enmedio (Spain)
description: Yellow field with red bends from the upper hoist to the lower fly, crossed by a black cross throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cumbres de Enmedio (a bar, a key and a boar's head on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Cumbres de Enmedio; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
